title: Pickup
summary: Overlap adds one to ammo, then destroys the pickup.

nodes.note: The pickup actor overlaps the player. On a server, check the other actor is a pawn before you grant ammo.
Read the current ammo so you add to it instead of replacing it.
One round, or one item. A data asset should own the stack size later.
Ammo plus one. Do the add on the server so two clients cannot both grant it.
Write the new total. Replicate ammo if the HUD on other machines must match.

nodes.label: Destroy Actor
nodes.note: Destroy the pickup after the grant. Destroying first would skip the add if the overlap ended the actor early.
